result.topic_en: Riemann describes the motion of a rotating fluid ellipsoid whose shape stays constant: the fluid particles move in ellipses about the instantaneous rotation axis, with a period given by $2\pi/\sqrt{g^2+r_1^2}$, and he notes cases still to be treated, including $b\geq a$ and $t^2 > 2\pi g^4\cdot 8{,}64003\ldots$.

methods.what: Internal motion: fluid particles move in ellipses parallel to the tangent plane at the axis endpoints, centred on the rotation axis, obeying the area law (equal areas in equal times), with period 2π/√(g²+r₁²)
methods.quote:

und durchlaufen sie in der Zeit $\frac{2\pi}{\sqrt{g^2+r_1^2}}$.

items.english: that constancy of the shape is necessarily accompanied by a constancy of the state of motion

items.english: That is, whenever the fluid mass continually forms the same body, the relative motion of all parts of this body also always remains the same.
